idiom-31-q46.truthCondition: The aunt assigned the brothers separate jobs to prevent them from arguing angrily all weekend.
idiom-31-q46.correctReason: 「Rather than let ...」表明姨姨用分配不同工作來避免兄弟整個週末爭吵。

foils.text: Rather than let the brothers fight like cat and dog all weekend, their aunt gave them one job to share.
foils.reason: 「one job to share」把各自不同的工作改成共用一項工作。

foils.text: Rather than let the brothers fight like cat and dog for one afternoon, their aunt gave each a separate job.
foils.reason: 「for one afternoon」把姨姨想避免的整個週末爭吵縮成一個下午。

foils.text: Rather than give them separate jobs, their aunt let the brothers fight like cat and dog all weekend.
foils.reason: 「let」表示姨姨放任爭吵，與原題說她採取行動避免爭吵相反。

idiom-31-q47.truthCondition: Anna and Beth had often argued fiercely before; the director expected renewed arguments unless rules were clear.
idiom-31-q47.correctReason: 正確句保留兩人有爭吵前例，以及規則不夠清楚便可能再次爭吵的條件。

foils.text: The director knew Anna and Beth would fight like cat and dog if the rules were made very clear.
foils.reason: 「if ... very clear」把原題的「除非規則清楚」倒轉成規則清楚才會爭吵。

foils.text: The director knew Anna and Beth had never fought like cat and dog before the rules were discussed.
foils.reason: 「had never」否定了原題說兩人以往經常激烈爭吵。

foils.text: The director knew Anna and Beth would work calmly together unless the rules were made very clear.
foils.reason: 「work calmly together」把規則不清時預期再爭吵改成預期和平合作。

idiom-31-q48.truthCondition: Two former friends argued fiercely for years, then finally sat down and solved their main problem.
idiom-31-q48.correctReason: 正確句保留多年爭吵之後終於坐下解決主要問題的時間與結果。

foils.text: The two former friends solved their main problem before they began fighting like cat and dog for years.
foils.reason: 「before」把解決問題移到多年爭吵之前，倒轉原題的先後。

foils.text: After years of fighting like cat and dog, the two former friends finally avoided discussing their main problem.
foils.reason: 「avoided discussing」把坐下解決問題改成迴避討論。

foils.text: After one day of fighting like cat and dog, the two former friends finally solved their main problem.
foils.reason: 「one day」把多年激烈爭吵縮成一天。

idiom-31-q49.truthCondition: A family meal ended early because two uncles resumed a fierce argument over an old disagreement.
idiom-31-q49.correctReason: 正確句保留舊有分歧令兩名叔伯再次爭吵，並因此使家庭聚餐提早結束的因果。

foils.text: The family meal ended early because two uncles started fighting like cat and dog over a new disagreement.
foils.reason: 「new disagreement」把舊有分歧改成新出現的分歧。

foils.text: The family meal continued late even though two uncles fought like cat and dog over an old disagreement.
foils.reason: 「continued late」把聚餐提早結束改成持續至很晚。

foils.text: Two uncles started fighting like cat and dog because the family meal had already ended early.
foils.reason: 這句說聚餐提早結束引起爭吵；原題說爭吵使聚餐提早結束。

idiom-31-q50.truthCondition: Ivy and Freya usually argue fiercely but this time cooperated to help their younger brother.
idiom-31-q50.correctReason: 正確句保留平日爭吵與這次合作的對比，也保留幫助弟弟的目標。

foils.text: Although Ivy and Freya rarely fight like cat and dog, they worked together to help their younger brother.
foils.reason: 「rarely」把平日經常激烈爭吵改成很少爭吵。

foils.text: Although Ivy and Freya usually fight like cat and dog, they argued again instead of helping their younger brother.
foils.reason: 「argued again instead of helping」把這次合作幫忙改成再次爭吵而沒有幫忙。

foils.text: Although Ivy and Freya usually fight like cat and dog, they worked together to help their older sister.
foils.reason: 「older sister」把受幫助的人由弟弟改成姐姐。
